download_quality_selection_screen__quali.name: download_quality_selection_screen__quality_options
download_quality_selection_screen__quali.description: A list of radio buttons for selecting video quality for downloading, including Full HD, High, Medium, and Low.

download_quality_selection_screen__cance.name: download_quality_selection_screen__cancel_button
download_quality_selection_screen__cance.description: A button to cancel the download quality selection and close the bottom sheet.

download_quality_selection_screen__downl.name: download_quality_selection_screen__download_button
download_quality_selection_screen__downl.description: A button to confirm the download quality selection and start downloading the video.
download_quality_selection_screen__downl.effect: tap to navigate to the search_results_screen, which displays a search input field with a clear button, a list of suggested search terms, and a bottom navigation bar with buttons for Home, Shorts, Create, Subscriptions, and You. The main content area shows a list of video entries, and a snackbar message indicates a download in progress.

download_quality_selection_screen__remem.name: download_quality_selection_screen__remember_settings_checkbox
download_quality_selection_screen__remem.description: A checkbox to remember the user's download quality settings for future downloads.

download_warning_dialog__action_buttons.name: download_warning_dialog__action_buttons
download_warning_dialog__action_buttons.description: A list of action buttons for the download warning dialog, including options to cancel or proceed with the download.
download_warning_dialog__action_buttons.effect: tap to navigate to the podcast_playlist_screen, which displays a header with a podcast image, title, channel name, and episode count, along with buttons for playing all episodes, saving the playlist, downloading, and sharing. A message banner indicates unavailable videos are hidden. The list of episodes includes video thumbnails, durations, titles, authors, and view counts. The bottom navigation bar includes buttons for Home, Shorts, Create, Subscriptions, and You, with the You button selected.

remove_downloaded_playlist_dialog__actio.name: remove_downloaded_playlist_dialog__action_buttons
remove_downloaded_playlist_dialog__actio.description: A list of action buttons in the remove_downloaded_playlist_dialog, including options to cancel or remove the playlist.
remove_downloaded_playlist_dialog__actio.effect: tap to navigate to the podcast_playlist_screen, which displays a header with podcast details, buttons for various actions, a message banner, a list of episodes, and a bottom navigation bar.

playlists_screen__navigate_up_button.name: playlists_screen__navigate_up_button
playlists_screen__navigate_up_button.description: A button to navigate back to the previous screen from the playlists screen.
playlists_screen__navigate_up_button.effect: tap to navigate to the user_profile_screen, which displays account management options, history, playlists, and other sections.

playlists_screen__cast_button.name: playlists_screen__cast_button

playlists_screen__more_options_button.name: playlists_screen__more_options_button
